step1_analysis.description: A high-speed continuous-time latched comparator used as a 1-bit quantizer in a delta-sigma ADC. It consists of a pre-amplifier stage, a master latch, and a slave latch, implemented using Current Mode Logic (CML).

paper_reference.title: High Dynamic Range InP HBT Delta-Sigma Analog-to-Digital Converters

Clock Frequency.description: Maximum operating clock frequency of the latched comparator.

sky130_expected.calculation: CML logic speed is typically limited by the RC time constant of the pull-up resistors and parasitic capacitances. With fT ~ 40GHz for SKY130 NMOS, CML can operate up to fT/20.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted from InP HBT (which is much faster) to 130nm CMOS capabilities.

Power Consumption.description: DC power dissipation of the comparator.

sky130_expected.calculation: 9 tail current sources * ~1mA per source = 9mA total current. 9mA * 1.8V VDD = 16.2mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on typical CML biasing in 130nm CMOS to achieve GHz speeds.

Propagation Delay.description: Delay from the active clock edge to the output transition.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the RC delay of the slave latch and output buffer stages. R_pu = 400 ohm, C_load ~ 100fF -> tau = 40ps. Delay is typically 2-3 tau.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard delay for CML latches in 130nm technology.

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing = I_tail * R_pu. With I_tail = 1mA and R_pu = 400 ohms, single-ended swing is 0.4V. Differential swing is 0.8Vpp.
sky130_expected.reasoning: CML logic requires a swing large enough to fully switch the differential pairs without pushing them into deep triode.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power consumption, output voltage swing, and propagation delay of the latched comparator. The netlist is adapted for SKY130 NMOS by replacing NPNs with NMOS, mapping GND to VDD (1.8V), and VEE to 0V.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Latched Comparator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Supply Voltages (Adapted for 1.8V CMOS CML)
VVDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
VVR V_R 0 DC 0.6

* Clocks (1 GHz, Common Mode = 0.8V, Swing = 0.4Vpp)
VCLK_P CLK_P 0 DC 0.8 PULSE(0.6 1.0 0 20p 20p 480p 1n)
VCLK_N CLK_N 0 DC 0.8 PULSE(1.0 0.6 0 20p 20p 480p 1n)

* Inputs (110 MHz, Common Mode = 1.6V, Swing = 0.4Vpp)
VIN_P IN_P 0 DC 1.6 SIN(1.6 0.2 110MEG 0 0 0)
VIN_N IN_N 0 DC 1.6 SIN(1.6 0.2 110MEG 0 0 180)

.control
* DC Operating Point for Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 20n
let out_diff = v(Q_P) - v(Q_N)
let clk_diff = v(CLK_P) - v(CLK_N)

* Measure Output Swing
meas tran v_max max out_diff
meas tran v_min min out_diff
let swing = v_max - v_min
print swing

* Measure Propagation Delay
meas tran t_pd trig clk_diff val=0 fall=2 targ out_diff val=0 cross=1

quit
.endc
